bead.title: Skip opted-out queues during emitter startup and ticks
bead.description:
PROBLEM: TD-008 CL-2 and CL-7 require per-queue opt-out to suppress delivery cleanly, but emitter startup and tick handling still need a single place to skip disabled queues and preserve cursor behavior.
ROOT CAUSE: docs/helix/02-design/technical-designs/TD-008-queue-history-change-records.md:64-65 defines opt-out semantics, while crates/pqueue-server/src/change_record_sink.rs:221-260 and crates/pqueue-server/src/lib.rs:1085-1102 contain the emitter startup and tick loop that must enforce it.
PROPOSED FIX: Update emitter startup and tick processing so opted-out queues are filtered before emission, skipped queues do not advance the emission cursor, and the default-on delivery path remains intact for enabled queues.
NON-SCOPE: No Kafka consumer surface, no engine record-mapping changes, no retention-frontier changes, and no claim-path coupling; this remains a background delivery feature only.
bead.acceptance:
1. `TestEmitChangeRecordTickSkipsOptedOutQueues` proves opted-out queues are never emitted.
2. `TestEmitChangeRecordTickDoesNotAdvanceCursorForOptOut` proves skipping a queue does not advance the emission cursor.
3. `go test ./... -run 'TestEmitChangeRecordTickSkipsOptedOutQueues|TestEmitChangeRecordTickDoesNotAdvanceCursorForOptOut'`
4. `lefthook run pre-commit`
5. `lefthook run pre-push`
